title: Priestly trumpets overthrow Jericho
english: Jericho falls to the priests’ trumpets. At their blast the walls collapsed — the power of God’s word. Priests sound; the ark goes before. Six days of circling, on the seventh a shout — sabbath mystery and the end’s figure. The harlot and her house are saved by the scarlet sign.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: Anathema and devoted things
english: Not only walls but the ban: [[gold, silver, bronze, and iron are sacred to the Lord >> Bible:Joshua 6:19]]. Whoever steals from the devoted things defiles the people. First victory must be dedicated to God; private greed for what is sacred weakens the camp.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: Rahab joined to Israel
english: Rahab and all her kin are joined to Israel — the church from the nations. The window-sign holds until the coming; faith must hold to the end. Whoever leaves the house perishes.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
True OET: no ANF; do not copy Bruce FOTC 105 (Joshua).

title: Curse on rebuilding Jericho
english: [[Cursed be the man who rebuilds Jericho >> Bible:Joshua 6:26]] — to restore this world set in the evil one after its fall. Christ came to [[destroy the devil’s works >> Bible:1 John 3:8]]; whoever rebuilds lusts labors under the curse. Glory to Christ. Amen.
translator_notes: Copy-text Baehrens GCS 30 / Origenes Werke VII (1921), Rufinus Latin.
